title: Canva releases Dream Lab and first in-house image generation model Craft
summary: Canva rolled out Dream Lab across its platform, utilizing technology from Leonardo.ai and introducing Craft, a proprietary foundation model optimized for template layouts and 2K rendering.
research_notes:
Open a project in the Canva editor and select Dream Lab from the side panel tools.

Input a descriptive prompt detailing the intended subject, composition, and visual style.

Optionally upload a style reference image or apply aesthetic presets to guide visual output.

Generate visual candidates and place the selected image directly onto the canvas as an editable layout element.

Provide reference images alongside textual prompts to anchor specific brand aesthetic palettes and layout structure.

Utilize template-trained native models for structured commercial layouts where spatial hierarchy and text placement take precedence over photorealistic stock photography.
